name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
source: The head of the Tokugawa house and a youkai that is top class in strength. He is unexpectedly timid and gets startled easily, but it is his dream to conquer the humans one day and make everyone wear tanuki suits. He has a very long life span compared to humans, so he waits patiently for his chance.
